== Card-list wording, 8 November 2026 ==
The PC website card list ([https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] to 11 January 2013) gave the original text with “lose Force” (capital F) and no comma after “or your card)”: “If you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose Force during opponent's control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card) that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1).” Whether a capitals/punctuation-only difference counts as a version is waiting for a ruling, so it has no page of its own; [[Imperial Propaganda (V)]] keeps the release-sheet wording.
